Evaluation attempt must bind the exact request, completed training outputs, summary, corpus and raw/H200 files, frozen96-token identity and descriptive sample settings.

The existing three-pilot boundary still requires all three completed pilots before compiling the candidate cleanup manifest. Unexpected later pilot slot directories are refused rather than ignored.

Mutation tests update downstream worker reference hashes to ensure semantic identity/claims/lineage rejection, not just stale-hash detection. Missing successful producer records, omitted metrics, altered sample settings, partial prefixes and later unreviewed attempts are covered.
limitations: Tests use synthetic saved records and tiny files; they do not establish actual numerical, training, cache or resource measurements. Reviewing saved provenance cannot replace execution of the underlying audits.
